title: Nectar d’oseille ou de foléré (Roselle Calyx Drink)
author: Tata Ngome et al. (CIFOR-ICRAF, IRAD, Université de Ngaoundéré)
desc: A kilogram of roselle calyces soaked 10 minutes, boiled 20 minutes, cooled, filtered and sweetened with sugar to taste — also called simi or oworo.
longDesc: p. 71 of the October 2023 recipe book. Calyces are sorted to remove impurities, soaked in 5 l of drinking water 10 minutes to soften, boiled 20 minutes, removed from the heat and the juice left to cool; filtered through a fine white cloth or sieve; sugar added to the desired taste; the juice bottled and kept cool. The page says the drink, also called simi or oworo, is much liked by young and old. The ingredient list prints 4 litres of water while the method prints 5 l — a SUSPECTED MISPRINT/CONFLICT, not corrected; the diagram also says soaking in 5 l and shows 65 degrees.
ingredients: 4 litres drinking water (the method says 5 l)
steps: Sort the calyces and remove impurities.
Soak in 5 l of drinking water for 10 minutes to soften them.
Boil 20 minutes. Remove from the heat and let the juice cool.
Filter through a fine white cloth or sieve.
Add sugar to the desired taste and mix.
chefTips: The printed cues are ‘to soften’ for the soak and sugar ‘to taste’.
Water: 4 l in the list and 5 l in the method — pick one and note it.
commonMistakes: Adding all 2 kg sugar without tasting.
storage: Keep cool (‘conserver au frais’). No shelf life is printed.
healthBenefits: Roselle is a tart calyx drink; sweetened.
culturalNote: The book attributes its recipes to the northern part of Cameroon and names no community, lamidat or town for any recipe. The page title also offers the name ‘nectar de foléré’ and names simi or oworo.
sources: Title as printed: ‘Nectar d’oseille ou nectar de foléré’ (p. 71). Authors as printed: ‘Tata Ngome et al.’ (CIFOR-ICRAF, IRAD, Université de Ngaoundéré; ReSI-NoC project); October 2023 (V1), © 2024, CC BY 4.0. Yield not printed for any recipe in the book. Servings 15, prep and the 10-minute soak split are placeholders. TWO-PASS for the text; diagram details single-pass.

SUSPECTED MISPRINT/CONFLICT, not corrected: water 4 litres in the list vs 5 l in the method and diagram; diagram also shows ‘Cuisson 65°’ and a stray ‘jus brut de gingembre’ label. ABSENT: shelf life.
